When I was about 12 I saw Dragon the Bruce Lee story on TV. I got so pumped up by that movie I immediately started doing pushups, pullups and random bodyweight exercises I invented everyday. My parents noticed and got me a weight set for chistmas. Then when I left home the thing I was actually most excited about was the prospect of having access to a proper gym. Been working out ever since!
How did you get involved in fitness?
Always been active. After surgery I had to push it, to recover. Now gymming about 3x a week, and a few specific sports aside from that.

It started when I played football (proper 'Murican football) in high school and I gained an appreciation for lifting the weights. Then in college an older student who was in to competitive bodybuilding introduced me to a more professional gym. And it stuck. Been lifting the heavy weights ever since.

I was skinny as a kid but filled with fatlogic thanks to my family. Thought getting fat was just a part of getting older. I was active as a kid but didn't realize it until I graduated college and the pounds started slowly piling on. Eventually found myself winded from carrying a few boxes up one flight of stairs while my friend felt fine. I sat perpendicular to a mirror to rest and then finally saw how fat I had truly gotten. I knew from looking at the scale that I was 65 pounds heavier than when I was in college but it never really sunk in until that moment.

After that, I started to diet and slowly exercise more. I got back down to 10 lbs heavier than college and stagnated until I met my wife. She did weightlifting from time to time and got me started on it. Lost 35 more lbs for our wedding and realized that even in college I was a little chubby. Now I'm trying to bulk and finally have some real muscles like I always wanted as a kid.

I just thought I could never be physically strong because of the fatlogic I was fed.
